summary.text: Gary Richardson, a Republican from Evans, was elected in a special election to succeed Rep. Barry Fleming and was sworn in to the Georgia House of Representatives on March 20, 2024.

paragraphs.text: Richardson represents District 125, which includes portions of Columbia and McDuffie counties, and previously served as the Columbia County commissioner for District 3 for eight years.

sources.title: Rep. Gary Richardson Sworn in to Georgia House of Representatives for 2023-2024 Legislative Term
